title: telosma odoratissima
intro: Telosma odoratissima, commonly known as the fragrant telosma or Queen of the Slumber, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Asclepiadaceae. This plant is valued for its calming effects and is traditionally used to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of Telosma odoratissima include its ability to lower blood pressure and improve sleep quality, while its therapeutic actions include sedative, hypnotic, and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
